verdict.rationale: Deepgram's docs say a voice agent lets you choose which STT model transcribes the user (docs-10), inside a single real-time WebSocket pipeline that takes audio in (docs-1). The CLI also streams live audio for transcription (docs-12). That covers real-time transcription with model-level control, but the pack never shows key-term boosting, swapping in third-party STT providers, or any accuracy evidence. Missing for 10: keyterm/vocabulary prompting, choice of STT provider beyond Deepgram's own models, independent accuracy benchmarks or hands-on corroboration.
